summary: Quiet dead-end street beside parkland, but apartments sit 16-24 m away on the same side.

best_section.where: Southern end of Bryce Street, west kerb, beside the hedged apartment block

drivers.seclusion: Bush and park across the road. Apartments (River Park View) 16 m and 24 m from the section's start on the same side; a larger house nearer the north end.
drivers.access_and_room: Open street, no gate. Cars park along the road so there is room to pull in.
drivers.traffic: Short side street off a main road; little through traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park along the street; signs are 2P with resident exceptions, handled by the screen.

flags: Slope about 5% over the section; steeper than 3%
Low-lying: about 6-7 m elevation, Brisbane River 200 m away
Apartment 8 m from the kerb near 51 m, so avoid the north end
sun_shade: Trees and hedge on the west side shade the morning; open to the afternoon sun from the park side.
